title: Transplant follow-up; history specifies kidney
encounterNote: 49-year-old male presents for routine follow-up of transplant. He reports no fever, chills, dysuria, or weight change. Current medications: tacrolimus 2 mg twice daily and mycophenolate 500 mg twice daily. Examination: blood pressure 122/78, temperature 36.8 C; no edema. Laboratory results: creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, unchanged from prior; tacrolimus trough 7.2 ng/mL. Assessment: transplant status, stable; continue current immunosuppression and follow up in three months.
